mcp.cli.paste: Paste the agent’s public key (one line ssh-ed25519 AAAA…) and press Ctrl-D:
mcp.err.damaged: The key is damaged: its body does not match its type {type}.
mcp.err.dsa: DSA keys are outdated and unsafe — make an ed25519 one: ssh-keygen -t ed25519.
mcp.err.empty: Paste the public key as one line: ssh-ed25519 AAAA… (the file ~/.ssh/<name>.pub).
mcp.err.exists: This agent key is already there ({fp}).
mcp.err.fp: The key fingerprint looks like SHA256:… from the list of agent keys.
mcp.err.label: The key label: Latin letters, digits and . _ @ -, up to 32 characters.
mcp.err.no_key: There is no agent key {fp} (Kaskad does not touch other lines of authorized_keys).
mcp.err.not_ssh: This is not an SSH public key: “ssh-ed25519 AAAA… comment” is expected.
mcp.err.one_line: Exactly one public key on one line is needed.
mcp.err.options: The key has its own options in front (command=, from=, environment= …) — they are not accepted: Kaskad sets the options itself. Paste the line that starts with the key type.
mcp.err.private: This is a PRIVATE key — never give it to anyone. The public one is needed: the .pub file.
mcp.err.root_key: This key already gives full root login to the server — it can’t become an agent key: sshd takes the first matching line. Make a separate key for the agent: ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -f ~/.ssh/kaskad_agent.
mcp.err.rsa_short: The RSA key is shorter than {bits} bits — make an ed25519 one: ssh-keygen -t ed25519.
mcp.err.too_long: Too long for a public key.
mcp.err.type: Unknown key type ({type}): ssh-ed25519, ecdsa-sha2-… or ssh-rsa is needed.
mcp.help.add: add: a public key from standard input (stdin)
mcp.help.del: remove an agent key by its SHA256:… fingerprint
mcp.help.dry_run: only check the key, write nothing
mcp.help.host: the server’s address for the ready connection command
mcp.help.label: label (Latin letters, up to 32 characters)
mcp.help.list: agent keys and how to connect
mcp.help.mcp: MCP server for AI agents: the agents’ SSH keys
mcp.text.added: Agent key added: it can run only kaskad-mcp.
mcp.text.removed: Agent key removed: it can’t connect any more.
mcp.text.removed_all: Key removed. Other agents may have disconnected too: it wasn’t clear which connection is whose. If an agent stops answering, restart its app.
mcp.text.removed_cut: Agent key removed and its connections closed: it can’t connect any more.
